summary:
**Status: complete** (small scoped fix; one real leftover fixed, rest verified clean).

## Summary

The in-app update check itself was already clean: `src/platform/update.rs` derives both the download page and the API URL from `env!("CARGO_PKG_REPOSITORY")`, and `Cargo.toml` carries the canonical `repository = "https://github.com/kolisachint/inkuno"` — so `releases_url()` and the `api.github.com/repos/kolisachint/inkuno/releases/latest` endpoint resolve correctly, matching what `book/src/updates.md` documents.

The **one real leftover** was in the release pipeline the updater depends on: `scripts/release.sh` defaulted to the `OWNER/inkuno` placeholder. Run without `INKUNO_REPO` set, `gh release create`, the release-state listing, and the `release-native.yml` dispatch would all target a nonexistent `OWNER/inkuno` repo — so no draft/public release would ever land in `kolisachint/inkuno` for the in-app updater to find. Fixed the default to `kolisachint/inkuno` and updated the two prose lines that described the placeholder (script header comment, `RELEASING.md`), keeping the documented rename-crew pointer intact.

## Files changed (uncommitted, nothing pushed)

- `scripts/release.sh` — `REPO="${INKUNO_REPO:-OWNER/inkuno}"` → `REPO="${INKUNO_REPO:-kolisachint/inkuno}"`; header comment no longer calls TITLE/REPO placeholders.
- `RELEASING.md` — default-repo sentence updated to `kolisachint/inkuno` (short sentences, per guide style).
- Diff stat: 2 files, 6 insertions, 5 deletions. Branch `agent/update-check-inkuno`, base `4104d2b`, left uncommitted as instructed.

## Verification

- Sweep `grep -rni "bref\|alarboulletmarin\|OWNER/inkuno\|astrolabe"` over `src/platform/update.rs`, `src/shell/updates.rs`, `src/views/palette.rs`, `packaging/macos/Info.plist`, `com.inkuno.Inkuno.desktop`, `inkuno.metainfo.xml`, `scripts/release*`, `book/src/updates.md`: `OWNER/inkuno` is gone. Remaining hits are documented/intentional (see below).
- `releases_url()` resolves to `https://github.com/kolisachint/inkuno/releases/latest` via `CARGO_PKG_REPOSITORY`; UI (`updates.rs`, `palette.rs` "Update Inkuno to…"), `updates.md`, `Info.plist` (`com.inkuno.Inkuno`), desktop and metainfo (`com.inkuno.Inkuno`, `kolisachint/inkuno` URLs) are all Inkuno-clean.
- `bash -n scripts/release.sh`: OK.
- `python3 scripts/test-release.py` (run via `/tmp/inkuno` symlink since the test requires the checkout dir be named `inkuno`): **12 tests, OK** — covers the edited `release.sh`.
- `python3 scripts/test-publish-release.py`: 13/14 pass; the 1 failure (`WorkflowContractTests…nightly…`, asserts the word "nightly" absent from a workflow whose own comment says "the old push-driven nightly release was removed") **fails identically on the pristine base** (verified via `git stash`) — pre-existing, untouched by this change.
- `cargo test --locked update`: **cannot build in this environment** — fails in the `gpui@0.2.2` build script: `metal shader compilation failed: xcrun: error: unable to find utility "metal"`. Environmental (Command Line Tools without the `metal` compiler; full Xcode needed), occurs before any Inkuno code compiles, and is independent of this diff (no Rust/Cargo files touched). Stated plainly as required.

## Deliberately left alone (with reason)

- `src/platform/vault.rs` `bref`/`encre` config-dir migration shims and `.bref-icons` fallbacks — intentional backward-compat for existing users' config folders (per brief, do not remove).
- `scripts/publish-release.py:20` allowlist `{"inkuno", "spot", "astrolabe"}` — not a bref leftover; `spot`/`astrolabe` are sibling apps sharing this release-script template (confirmed by `test-release.py`'s "run this test from one of the native application repositories" guard). The script derives asset names from `Cargo.toml`, so for Inkuno it only ever emits `inkuno-*`. Narrowing it would break the shared template — out of scope.
- `bref` pointer comments in `release.sh:12` / `publish-release.py:23` — documented ownership pointers to the rename crew, consistent with the `RELEASING.md` naming-seam note and `ARCHITECTURE.md:6` origin credit.

## Open questions

- None blocking. Note for the coordinator: `cargo test` needs a machine with full Xcode (`metal` compiler) — worth running the `update` module tests there before merge, though this diff touches no Rust code.
